intended_object: The canonical bijection between the dependent sum Σ i, ULift (PLift (P i)) and the subtype {x // P x}, sending ⟨i, h⟩ to ⟨i, h⟩. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation:
The definition composes two equivalences. `sigmaCongrRight` with `Equiv.ulift` removes the `ULift` wrapper in each fiber, and `sigmaPLiftEquivSubtype` then sends `Σ i, PLift (P i)` to `Subtype P`. This gives exactly the canonical map ⟨i, h⟩ ↦ ⟨i, h⟩.

On generality: `Sigma` needs `α` to be a `Type`, so `α : Type v` is the right setting, and the universe of the `ULift` is left free. The definition is already as general as it can be.

The mathlib_counterpart field names `Equiv.sigmaPLiftEquivSubtype`, the closest existing declaration. It is the variant without the `ULift` wrapper, not the same equivalence. This definition is a universe-lifted version of it and is built from it.
